provenance.source: https://github.com/near/intents/blob/75d2976949f2b05693133b123e8eefb3f14add05/crates/signatures/nep641/src/message.rs, the doc tests of OffchainMessage::hash and OffchainMessage::into_nep413_payload (near/intents at 75d2976949f2b05693133b123e8eefb3f14add05, committed 2026-10-20, the last commit touching crates/signatures/nep641 on 2026-11-14), the reference implementation NEP-641 names
provenance.notes: Copied as data from the raw file at that commit, read with WebFetch on 2026-11-14 (upstream data is not on a chain, so the capture script does not read it). The hash vector's message has path [wallet.near]; the NEP-413 mapping vector's has path [wallet.near, v1.signer]: so the second nonce is not the first hash. DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is b"NEAR_NEP641_OFFCHAIN_MESSAGE/V1" in the same file. nep641.test.ts recomputes all of it; a copying error would fail it.
